requirement: The system shall respect SiteMinder authentication, direct users to landing pages appropriate to their roles, restrict access to pages according to login status and role, and direct unauthenticated users to sign in.
If a request made during a logged-in session receives an unauthorized response, the system shall end the user's session and display the session-expired page.
The system shall load infrequently changing reference-list data during initialization and make it available throughout the client, using NgRx to cache and share selected client-side data.
The system shall allow authorized users to view evacuee records; create, view, and update incident-task, organization, and registration records; and create, view, update, and delete referral records.
The system shall collect notifications intended for users and display them within the application.
The system shall support PDF collection as part of registration-related workflows.

The system shall support deactivating a selected volunteer in the MS SQL database using a maintenance script that updates only the record matching the supplied volunteer identifier and performs the update within a transaction. The target database shall be backed up before the script is executed.

The system shall use an Angular browser client communicating over HTTP with a .NET Core WebAPI backend, with server-side domain services and Entity Framework providing access to persistent data in MS SQL.
